        b = abs(cy - yCorner) <= r and 0 <= cx <= xCorner
        return a or b

        a = abs(cx - xCorner) <= r and 0 <= cy <= yCorner
        b = abs(cy) <= r and 0 <= cx <= xCorner
        return a or b
